snippet.title: Turnbound - Gameplay Walkthrough Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2025 Showcase
snippet.description:
Step into the haunted world of Turnbound, a unique auto-battler where your strategic prowess is your only escape. Developed by 1TK, this game challenges you to outsmart other trapped souls by assembling and optimizing a grid of weapons, relics, and trinkets. Each choice you make can lead to devastating synergies or catastrophic failure. With asynchronous PvP battles, you’ll face off against the designs of other players, testing your strategies in a battle of wits.

Will your design outlive your opponents… or will your soul remain trapped?

Turnbound is currently available as a free demo on Steam. Wishlist the full game to stay updated on its release.
